verdict.rationale: Drata's developer portal says AI agents can interact with Drata and manage compliance workflows and controls through natural language, and it publishes an official MCP setup and usage guide (drata-docs-2, drata-docs-54, drata-probe-4). Natural-language operation therefore depends on an external AI client connected through MCP, and the evidence is only a one-line claim with no detail on scope. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documentation of which operations work by natural language, hands-on or independent corroboration.
